notes: Critical updater hardening after 1.1.1 was observed opening many terminal windows at once during an upgrade. Three defenses: (1) Python-side re-entry guard refuses a second call to download_and_install_update while a download or install is already in flight, so a double-click can no longer spawn two installers. (2) Filesystem lockfile inside the updates folder: if a second apply_update.cmd ever starts, it sees the lock and exits immediately rather than fighting over the file move. (3) The installer cmd no longer mixes DETACHED_PROCESS with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, and the relaunch uses start /B so no new console window can appear even when the parent is hidden. Also includes the three AI-first features from 1.1.2: live 'Why is my PC slow?' triage, battery coach with per-discharge-cycle de-duplication, and the game and heavy-app narrator with full Dospara GALLERIA roster. Non-intrusive by design: all background daemons suppress toasts during fullscreen apps and back off when the CPU is busy. First-time users see a one-shot help coachmark. XSS audit converted eleven user-controllable render sites to safe-escape. Narrate-only rule enforced: new features never open or close any app, they only describe.
